g.text: Bangla and Hindi books: words that come out whole

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: 22 book-layout PDFs (one and two columns, running headers, hyphenation, footnotes). A word run into its neighbour or broken apart is not whole: selection, read-aloud and word counts fail on it.
